messages:
Rina Shah: Quick check on a small hover toolbar prototype for the playground. It shows Stop (label + icon), a tiny Cost chip, and a kebab with Regenerate / Save to prompt library. Link: https://redwood.internal/s/hover-compact-1
Matt Geller: Looks tidy. Mobile note: hovering won't work — need keyboard/focus states that trigger the toolbar. Also avoid layout shift when cost updates.
Priya Raman: Agree. Proposal: toolbar is absolutely positioned so it never pushes content. Cost chip shows a stable rounded estimate and opens a dialog with full breakdown when tapped.
Samir Desai: Backend suggestion: add ?cost_stream=true that emits cost snapshots at 300ms. Frontend should throttle renders to 300ms and animate number transitions rather than reflow.
Elena Brooks: Accessibility: Stop should have accessible name "Stop generation" and cost dialog must be role=dialog with focus trap. Color contrast for the cost chip needs to reach 4.5:1 in both light and dark modes.
Rina Shah: Microcopy: prefer label 'Cost' on the chip and 'Regenerate response' in the menu. Product asks for a soft confirm if estimated cost > $0.60. Not a block, just a confirm modal.
Matt Geller: Keyboard shortcuts: Esc to stop, Ctrl+Enter to regenerate (user setting to opt into shortcut). Show the shortcut in tooltip.
Priya Raman: Analytics: track toolbar_shown, cost_dialog_opened, regen_attempted, regen_confirmed, stop_via_shortcut. We'll use that to tune the soft-confirm threshold.
Samir Desai: I'll add snapshot seq numbers and session_id so the client can ignore out-of-order events. Also emit final_cost on stream end. PR coming this week.
Elena Brooks: I'll run an a11y sweep once updated frames are up. Rina, please tag me when you push Figma updates.
Rina Shah: Thanks all  updating comps now and will post frames + checklist shortly. :sparkles:
